name: Eurowag Group plc
summary: Eurowag Group plc develops and sells integrated digital platform, payment, mobility, and financial solutions for the commercial road transport (CRT) industry in Europe. It operates through two segments: Payment Solutions and Mobility Solutions. The Payment Solutions segment offers energy payment solutions, and toll payment solutions for conventional fuels, alternative energy, eMobility, and acceptance networks.
